name: Bouquet Canyon Park
note: City of Santa Clarita park in Saugus (28127 Wellston Dr): 8 dedicated outdoor pickleball courts in one fenced pen (the city's count), two rows of four on what were two tennis courts, free and first come; the basketball court, the softball field, the playground and the restroom beside them, Bouquet Canyon Elementary next door.
_lit: court lights: the owner confirms the courts are lit at night (2026-10-07; the city's older listing also says 'lighted tennis court'); the aerial doesn't resolve the poles, so they stand by rule along the pen's long sides
_anchor: the z20 aerial's anchor: en points are meters east/north of it

spawn._src: by the pickleball courts, facing them (the owner, 2026-10-09: "spawn to the area where the pickleball courts are"); the old arrival: the park's lot east of the courts (OSM 995954595)

courts._drop: OSM's two 'pickleball' pitches are the two old tennis courts (37 x 18.5 m each); the aerial shows four pickleball courts on each, so the eight are placed from the aerial
courts._add: court centres traced off the Esri z20 aerial (two rows of four, long axis at bearing 170.4, 8.9 m apart in each old tennis court, 9.25 m across its middle, rows 18 m apart); they agree with OSM's two pitches within 3 m

_colors: court and kitchen one blue, a grey-green surround: the owner's two photos (2026-10-08), the sunlit bright mode of each paint's hue class, between the evening wide shot and the overexposed midday one (the aerial's hazy #46668a / #5f6e5c read too dark and grey)

fence._room: the pen is a standard double tennis enclosure, 36.6 x 36.6 m (120 x 120 ft): fence lines read off the court-aligned z20 aerial (the windscreens' shadows fall north-west: west and north fences at the band's inner edge, south and east at the outer) and the owner's wide photo (its fence foot at s -19.5, 1.7 m off court 5's sideline); 1.71 m beside the outer sidelines, 2.62 m behind the baselines
fence._types: measured in the owner's photos (solved poses, compare.mjs solve; scratchpad meas.py): the perimeter 3.65 m (12 ft) chain-link with black windscreen from 0.15 to 3.0 m (wide photo, 9.8 m away); galvanized posts every ~3 m; the east side bare chain-link (the car in the lot shows through it); the partitions 1.52 m (5 ft: 1.57 m in the partition photo, 1.45-1.67 by the ratio to the courts) with a mid rail at half height and a bottom rail, black vinyl mesh on galvanized posts (~0.09 m) every ~3 m
fence._partitions: a cross of low partitions: one across the pen between the two rows (both owner photos; the aerial's line), one down its middle between the two old tennis courts (courts 2|3 and 6|7: the aerial's line, and in the wide photo a 1.7 m fence on that line, measured 15 m out); none between the two courts of an old tennis court (the wide photo sees none between courts 5 and 6)
fence._openings: the shade alcove: the west fence opens into it where the cross partition ends (partition photo: no screen across it, the benches at the fence line); the alcove off the aerial (a dark box 2.8 x 6.4 m outside the west fence)
fence._lights: single shoebox heads on ~8 m galvanized poles along the west and east fences (wide photo: heads fitted at 7.8 and 8.3 m on the west fence at t -10 and -4.3, one on the east fence at t -16), one every 6.1 m by rule (within 1 m of those three)
fence._benches: benches: the owner confirms benches by the courts (2026-10-07), placed by rule outside the pen (exact spots not mapped or seen); still no bleachers by the courts or pro-shop kiosk (a city park with no pro shop)
fence._posts: round 4 (the owner's partition photo, measured against the 1.66 in top rail and the 1.52 m height): line posts ~2.875 in (0.073 m) with a loop cap the top rail runs through and a band at the mid rail; terminal posts at every run's end ~4 in (0.102 m) with a dome cap and tension bands up them; all hot-dip galvanized (light, a metallic sheen); the mesh black vinyl

trees._kinds: pines: the owner's photos show tall Aleppo-type pines all round the pen (north, west and south of it, 15 m or so: about twice the 8 m light poles); the trees east of the lot are broad-leaf (the wide photo's right edge)

_props: OSM: the five picnic tables (leisure=picnic_table nodes) and the two bleachers by the softball field (leisure=bleachers); the paddle wait board: owner confirms one (2026-10-07), spot approximate: outside the pen's east fence on the lot side, where players arrive
_benchesNow: the benches: the two the owner's partition photo shows under the shade alcove (a blue one and a dark one); the rule's benches round the pen had no spots

extras._src: aerial (the alcove box) + the owner's partition photo (a light flat metal roof near the fence top, dark posts)

_terrain: the hills round the park from the USGS 3DEP terrain (terrain.py, 15 m grid to 450 m): the dry-grass hillside behind the north fence in the owner's wide photo; the far ground's base colour is that hillside's dry grass (wide photo, sunlit); round 4: what covers it from the wide aerial (terrain-cover.py: grass, scrub in the ravines, bare trails, the bushes dotted over the grass per 7.5 m cell) in the owner's wide photo's colours (the hill's dry grass a muted tan, the scrub dark olive)
